description: Finalisation: edit public/sw.js ONCE (CACHE_NAME prezenty-v125 -> prezenty-v127, or max(127, main/sibling + 1)), bump ?v= on every linked CSS whose bytes changed vs e939a28 on every page that links it, keep urlsToCache consistent, run the full suite and the final snapshot compare, measure before/after bytes per CSS file and total CSS transferred for recipients.html and leaderboard.html, and write W/.agents/tasks/css-consolidate-1-verification.md. Depends on FEAT-001..004 (FEAT-004 may have been dropped).
steps: Determine changed CSS: git -P diff --name-only e939a28..HEAD -- public '*.css'. Read main and sibling cache names: git show main:public/sw.js | Select-Object -First 1; git show refactor/split-recipients-1:public/sw.js | Select-Object -First 1; target = max(127, highest + 1).

With a Node Buffer script (preserves EOL) bump CACHE_NAME and, for each changed file linked with ?v=N, set ?v=N+1 on EVERY page that links it (app-theme.css?v=14, bottom-tab-bar.css?v=42, filters.css?v=7, chat-reactions.css?v=3, aws-design.css?v=4 on recipients, <page>-page*.css?v=1) and the matching precache strings in urlsToCache; leave unversioned links/precache entries (styles.css, styles.deduped.min.css, aws-design.css on activity) unchanged and note why (server no-cache + cache-name bump); never change link order or add/remove precache entries. Validate: node --check public/sw.js; every local urlsToCache entry exists on disk once; git -P diff of HTML contains only ?v= changes (and the leaderboard href if FEAT-002 switched it). Commit: chore: bump service worker cache and CSS versions.

Run the full suite (npm test *> $env:TEMP\css-consolidate-1\e2e-after.txt): expect 121 passed, 0 failed, 11 skipped (or the FEAT-001 reference). Capture the final snapshot and compare with css-baseline (zero diffs, or --allow overflow-container only if FEAT-004 landed, and show the plain compare lists only those cells).

Measure bytes: per CSS file before (git cat-file -s e939a28:public/<f>) vs after (HEAD) with delta, % and gzip; run tmp-css-transfer.js to transfer-after.json and tabulate decoded and transferred CSS for recipients.html and leaderboard.html before (from css-audit.md / transfer-before.json) vs after.

Write W/.agents/tasks/css-consolidate-1-verification.md per plan section 8 F.3 (results table, commits e939a28..HEAD, per-phase evidence, B decision with numbers, leaderboard decision with evidence, bytes tables, removed rules per file, D outcome, sw/?v changes, Decisions needed, Not covered, deviations). Commit: docs(css): add CSS consolidation verification.
